summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting two announcements. The primary one discloses the disposal of 1,174,694 common shares of Novatek Microelectronics Corporation at an average price of NTD 479.8 per share, total NTD 563,618,180, via conversion of zero-coupon exchangeable bonds due 2026. This is a routine debt conversion and securities disposal, not a special situation. The secondary announcement covers director/executive trading and pledges. No board resolution, advisor, or strategic event is present.
